Chapter 7189: Just A Mortal I Am

Chapter 7189: Just A Mortal I Am

The major worlds offered everything they had. Cultivators fortified their dao heart, wanting to contribute to their world. At the very least, this gave them a slight chance of survival.

In the past, overlords and immortals viewed living beings as insects. Today, they realized that all were equal beneath the looming calamity.

Defending the world was the only way to have a true future, rather than hiding and living a borrowed life. Moreover, the latter didn’t appear possible.

The numerous energy channels entered Desolate Frontier, boosting the defenders to their peak again. Moreover, their morale improved after seeing the support and sacrifice.

“Endure!” They roared and burned their true fate, pushing the wall to the limit.

Meanwhile, the flood gate above was fully open, releasing the strongest wave of tribulations thus far.

“Boom!” Cracks appeared on the wall.

“It’s coming!” Empress Hong Tian shouted.

The wave blasted through several parts of the wall manned by the weakest defenders. They exploded into pieces while bellowing in pain.

“Activate!” The leaders roared and risked their lives.

Alas, the wall had nearly crumbled at this point. Their own cultivation was insufficient to stop the wave.

“Boom!” Bolts pierced through them and crushed the wall entirely, leaving Heavenrealm exposed.

“No!” Immortals in other worlds screamed in horror and could only watch.

As the bolts traveled, they obliterated everything along the way.

“Damn it!” In this existential crisis, Duality Master made up his mind and rushed toward the flood.

He looked utterly insignificant against the massive bolts.

“Just a mortal I am.” He whispered and let out a sigh.

The bolts suddenly froze in place.

“Why must I ascend?” He lamented again before melting into the world.

“Buzz.” In the next second, copies of him appeared among the clouds, mud, and every inch of space.

The number of copies was incalculable, potentially ten times higher than all living beings.

Moreover, living beings started becoming him too. This applied to the past and the future, not just the present.

The countless horde stood before the tribulations. Although they were mortals, they had no choice but to touch the heaven in order to survive. They revealed their fangs despite the futility.

“Boom!” The lightning bolts struck the copies, reducing them to bloody mists.

“My fate is mine!” Duality Master spoke again.

His remark echoed in all minds and hearts across timelines, igniting confidence and hope.

“Boom!” This belief gathered before the waves, resulting in a miracle.

The bloody mists suddenly came together and the countless Duality Masters fused as one.
